title: Shared API definitions
description: Cursors, limits and the response parts more than one operation returns. Ledger values (ids, text, limits, enums) come from the ledger schemas.

cardNumber.description: A card's number on the board the operation names: 1, 2, 3... in the order its cards were drawn, never given again on that board

cardNumbers.description: Two or more distinct cards on the board, by number, each once

head.description: The ledger's latest `seq`; 0 when it is empty

limit.description: How many to return at most

wait.description: Seconds to hold the call until the person acts; 0 answers at once

linked.description: True adds the nodes linked to this one

more.description: Present, and true, only when there is more to read or the answer repeats an earlier one

nodeId.description: A node as the View names it: the string form of its number

itemStatus.description: Where a card stands with the person: `open`, it needs the person; `with-agent`, the person's latest note on it waits for your answer (a note never answers a card; your answer, a `reply` naming the note or a newer version, makes it `open` again); `checked` (✓) or `crossed` (✗), the only answers; `later`. `context` is no longer given: a note made with the old More context reads as `with-agent` while it waits.

pendingReason.description: Why a card of any kind waits for the agent: a note with no answer yet (`comment`, or `context` for a note made with the old More context), or moved to Later with no park bundle

note.description: One of the person's notes as it stands now: its latest text and kind. A removed note is left out.

seq.description: The `seq` of the `comment` or `context` act that made the note; `note-edit`, `note-remove` and a `reply`'s `to` name it by this.

kind.description: `comment`, or `context` for a note made with the old More context; either is a note.

sent.description: The person has pressed Send since writing it, so it is history and can no longer be edited or removed

locked.description: The note is history and can no longer be edited or removed: the person has pressed Send since writing it (`sent`), or the agent has answered it (a reply naming it in `to`, or a newer version of one of its cards)

nodes.description: For a note on a group of cards: every item it is on. Left out for a note on one card.

owed.description: This note waits for your answer: answer it with a `reply` whose `to` is its `seq`, or an `append`. The same rule as `list_open`'s `pending` and `containers`. A note without it needs nothing more from you: answered already (`answered` says by what), or not yours to answer. Only an agent's read is marked.

answered.description: This note is answered already: leave it, since a second answer clears the person's ✓ or ✗ again. A note with neither this nor `owed` is not yours to answer: on a card you may not answer, or an earlier note on a card whose latest note carries the mark. Only an agent's read is marked.

noteAnswer.description: What answered a note, the first that holds of: a `reply` naming it, a newer version of the card than the one it was made on (an `append` or a redraw), or the person's ✓ (`check`) or ✗ (`cross`) on the card after it. The same rule that ends `owed`.

kind.description: A reply naming the note in `to`.
A newer version of the card than the one the note was made on.

ver.description: The card's first version after the note.

kind.description: The person's ✓ (`check`) or ✗ (`cross`) on the card after the note.

seq.description: The line of the person's mark.

itemState.description: The person's answers on one item

unseenAnswer.description: Your answer to the card's latest note cleared its earlier ✓, ✗ or Later, and the person has not looked at the card since; left out otherwise

to.description: The `seq` of the person's action this answers.

proposal.description: An agent's proposed decision; `decidedBy` is the `seq` of the person's act that ended it, and `outcome` how

n.description: The card the proposal is about, by its number on the board.

ver.description: The node version the proposal is about.

decidedBy.description: The `seq` of the person's action that ended it; absent while it waits.

outcome.description: How it ended, with `decidedBy`: `accepted` (the person took it), `rejected` (turned down), or `closed` (the person's ✓ or ✗ on the card another way).

from.description: The card the link starts at, by its number on the board.

to.description: The card the link ends at, by its number on the board.

label.description: What the link means, in a few words.

nodeVersion.description: One version of a node: what the agent said, when, and who

agent.description: The agent that wrote this version.

node.description: What the agent said in this version.

nodeDetailCore.$comment: Left open so show_node can add `head` and `linked`. Was: api.md 6

n.description: The card's number on its board.

board.description: The board the node is on.

region.description: The container the node is in now.

moved_from.description: The region the agent drew the node in, when the person moved it to `region`; left out when it is where the agent drew it

status.description: Where the card stands with the person; every card has one. Only a question, decision or action is answered, by ✓ (`checked`) or ✗ (`crossed`); a note never answers a card.

size.description: The person's size; it wins over the agent's suggestion in `versions`

seen.description: The latest version the person has seen

versions.description: Every version of the node, oldest first.

notes.description: The person's comments and requests for context on the node.

replies.description: The agent's replies on the node.

proposals.description: The agent's proposed decisions on the node.

park.description: The handover bundle, when the node has been saved for later.

links.description: Links from or to this node

retired.description: The ledger line that took the card off the board, for a retired card; left out while it is on the board. Its history stays readable and its number is never given again.

openItem.description: An open card: a question, decision or action with no ✓ or ✗ yet, or a card of any kind that waits for the agent (`pending`). `pending` and `unseen` are left out when they do not apply

board.description: The board the item is on.

n.description: The card's number on its board.

region.description: The container the item is in.

moved_from.description: The region the agent drew the item in, when the person moved it to `region`; left out when it is where the agent drew it

status.description: Where the card stands with the person.

unseen.description: The item has a newer version than the person last saw, or your answer to its latest note cleared it, or you replied on it, and the person has not looked at it since

openContainer.description: A whole container whose latest note from the person has no answer yet. Answer it with a `reply` whose `to` is `note`.

board.description: The board the container is on.

pending.description: `comment`, or `context` for a note made with the old More context; either is a note.

note.description: The `seq` of the note waiting for an answer.
